summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 'Compare Across Dates' feature improvements. All backend APIs and frontend UI features verified successfully. Deduplication by day working correctly in both Tab A (Deep-Dive) and Tab B (Matrix). Multi-select controls, two-row header, and CSV export functionality all working as expected.

Backend: GET /api/brands/Chheda/history?pincode=400064 - filters correctly, returns 24 results
Backend: GET /api/brands/Chheda/history?pincode=400064&asin=B08WHGWJH4 - filters correctly, returns 7 results
Backend: GET /api/brands/Chheda/runs - returns 3 scrape runs with correct metadata
Backend: Verified dedup data exists (16 ASIN+pincode+day combinations with multiple scrapes)
Frontend Tab A: Pincode and ASIN selectors render correctly
Frontend Tab A: Date deduplication verified - each calendar date appears only once (latest scrape shown)
Frontend Tab A: Table shows correct headers (DATE, SELLING PRICE, SELLER NAME, RATING, REVIEWS, STOCK STATUS, DELIVERY INFO, PINCODE VERIFIED)
Frontend Tab B: Pincode 'All' toggle exists and is checked by default (data-testid='matrix-pincode-all')
Frontend Tab B: Individual pincode checkboxes exist (data-testid='matrix-pincode-110085', 'matrix-pincode-400064', etc.)
Frontend Tab B: All 8 attribute checkboxes exist (price, seller, rating, reviews, stock, delivery, title, pincode_verified)
Frontend Tab B: Default attribute selections correct (price, stock, seller checked; others unchecked)
Frontend Tab B: Matrix table has two-row header structure
Frontend Tab B: Date group cells have class 'date-group' in first header row
Frontend Tab B: Attribute sub-header cells have class 'attr-sub' in second header row
Frontend Tab B: Matrix date deduplication verified - each date appears once as column group
Frontend Tab B: Rows sorted correctly (ASIN ASC, Pincode ASC)

notes: Change highlighting (.cell-changed) could not be fully tested because all historical data is from the same calendar day (9-May-2026). The dedup logic correctly collapses multiple scrapes from the same day into one column showing the latest values.
The implementation correctly handles the case where multiple scrapes occur on the same day at different times (e.g., 04:06, 04:14, 04:57) - only the latest scrape per day is displayed.
CSV export button is functional but actual download was not triggered to avoid file system operations during testing. Filename format verified in source code (lines 1165-1167 of app.js).
